title_en: Application: A formula for the inverse of a matrix

t.en: Find the cofactor matrix and the adjugate of a matrix.
t.zh: 求矩阵的代数余子式矩阵和伴随矩阵。

t.en: Find the inverse of a matrix using the adjugate formula.
t.zh: 用伴随矩阵公式求矩阵的逆。

t.en: The determinant of a matrix also provides a way to find the inverse of a matrix. Recall the definition of the inverse of a matrix from Definition “The inverse of a matrix”. If $A$ is an $n\times n$-matrix, we say that $A^{-1}$ is the inverse of $A$ if $AA^{-1} = I$ and $A^{-1}A=I$.
t.zh: 行列式也提供了一种求逆矩阵的方法。回忆定义“矩阵的逆”中逆矩阵的定义：若 $A$ 是 $n\times n$ 矩阵，当 $AA^{-1} = I$ 且 $A^{-1}A=I$ 时，我们称 $A^{-1}$ 是 $A$ 的逆。

t.en: We now define a new matrix called the **cofactor matrix** of $A$. The cofactor matrix of $A$ is the matrix whose $\ijth$ entry is the $\ijth$ cofactor of $A$.
t.zh: 现在定义一个新的矩阵，称为 $A$ 的**代数余子式矩阵**（cofactor matrix）。$A$ 的代数余子式矩阵，是以 $A$ 的第 $\ijth$ 个代数余子式作为第 $\ijth$ 个元素的矩阵。

t.en: Let $A$ be an $n\times n$-matrix. Then the \textbfcofactor matrix of $A$, denoted $\cof(A)$, is defined by
t.zh: 设 $A$ 是 $n\times n$ 矩阵。则 $A$ 的**代数余子式矩阵**记作 $\cof(A)$，定义为

blocks.tex:
\cof(A)
    ~=~ \mat{C_{ij}}
    ~=~ \left[\begin{array}{cccc}
      C_{11} & C_{12} & \cdots & C_{1n} \\
      C_{21} & C_{22} & \cdots & C_{2n} \\
      \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\
      C_{n1} & C_{n2} & \cdots & C_{nn} \\
    \end{array}\right],

t.en: where $C_{ij}$ is the $\ijth$ cofactor of $A$.
t.zh: 其中 $C_{ij}$ 是 $A$ 的第 $\ijth$ 个代数余子式。

t.en: We will use the cofactor matrix to create a formula for the inverse of $A$. First, we define the **adjugate** of $A$, denoted $\adj(A)$, to be the transpose of the cofactor matrix:
t.zh: 我们将用代数余子式矩阵给出 $A$ 的逆的公式。首先，定义 $A$ 的**伴随矩阵**（adjugate），记作 $\adj(A)$，它是代数余子式矩阵的转置：

t.en: The adjugate is also sometimes called the **classical adjoint** of $A$.
t.zh: 伴随矩阵有时也称为 $A$ 的**经典伴随矩阵**（classical adjoint）。

t.en: It is always a good idea to double-check your work. At the end of the calculation, it is very easy to compute $A^{-1}A$ and check whether it is equal to $I$. If they are not equal, be sure to go back and double-check each step. One common mistake is to forget to take the transpose of the cofactor matrix, so be sure not to forget this step.
t.zh: 检验自己的计算结果总是个好习惯。计算做完之后，算出 $A^{-1}A$ 并看它是否等于 $I$ 是很容易的。如果不相等，一定要回头逐步检查。一个常见的错误是忘记对代数余子式矩阵取转置，所以千万不要漏掉这一步。

t.en: In practice, it is usually much faster to compute the inverse by the method of Section 〔引用〕, because this only requires solving a single system of equations, rather than computing a large number of cofactors. However, there are some situations where the adjugate formula is useful. One such situation is when the matrix has complicated entries that are functions rather than numbers. The following example illustrates this.
t.zh: 在实际计算中，用〔引用〕节的方法求逆通常要快得多，因为那只需要解一个方程组，而不必计算大量的代数余子式。不过，在有些情形下伴随矩阵公式是有用的。其中一种情形是矩阵的元素比较复杂，是函数而不是数。下面的例子说明了这一点。

stem.tex:
A =
    \left[\begin{array}{ccc}
      e^{t} & e^{-t}\cos t & e^{-t}\sin t \\
      e^{t} & -e^{-t}\cos t-e^{-t}\sin t & -e^{-t}\sin t+e^{-t}\cos t \\
      e^{t} & 2e^{-t}\sin t & -2e^{-t}\cos t
    \end{array}\right].

t.en: Does there exist a value of $t$ for which this matrix fails to be invertible? Explain.
t.zh: 是否存在 $t$ 的某个值，使这个矩阵不可逆？请说明理由。

sol.tex:
\det \left[\begin{array}{ccc}
        e^{t} & e^{-t}\cos t & e^{-t}\sin t \\
        e^{t} & -e^{-t}\cos t-e^{-t}\sin t & -e^{-t}\sin t+e^{-t}\cos t \\
        e^{t} & 2e^{-t}\sin t & -2e^{-t}\cos t
      \end{array}\right] = 5e^{-t} \neq 0

t.en: and so this matrix is always invertible.
t.zh: 所以这个矩阵总是可逆的。
